3.name: Dreadful Strikes
3.notes: You can infuse your weapon attacks with Feywild magic. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you may deal an extra 1d4 Psychic damage. A creature can take this extra damage only once per turn. This extra damage increases to 1d6 at Ranger level 11.

3.name: Fey Wanderer Spells
3.notes:
You always have the following spells prepared at the listed Ranger levels:

3rd: Charm Person
5th: Misty Step
9th: Summon Fey
13th: Dimension Door
17th: Mislead

You also gain a Feywild Gift (roll or choose):
1. Illusory butterflies appear during rests.
2. Flowers bloom from your hair each dawn.
3. You smell faintly of a comforting herb or spice.
4. Your shadow moves independently when not observed.
5. Horns or antlers grow from your head.
6. Your skin and hair shift color each dawn.

3.name: Otherworldly Glamour
3.notes:
You add your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) to all Charisma checks.

You also gain proficiency in one: Deception, Performance, or Persuasion.

7.name: Beguiling Twist
7.notes:
You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition.

Additionally, when you or a creature within 120 feet succeeds on a saving throw to avoid or end Charmed or Frightened, you may take a Reaction to force a different creature within 120 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, it is Charmed or Frightened (your choice) for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

11.name: Fey Reinforcements
11.notes:
You can cast Summon Fey without a Material component. You may also cast it once without a spell slot, regaining this ability after a Long Rest.

When you begin casting the spell, you may choose to remove the Concentration requirement. If you do, the spell's duration becomes 1 minute.

15.name: Misty Wanderer
15.notes:
You can cast Misty Step without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regaining all uses after a Long Rest.

When you cast Misty Step, you may bring along one willing creature within 5 feet. It teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice within 5 feet of your destination.
